examples.code:
# Composite a premultiplied foreground over a background plate.
foreground = nuke.toNode("FG_Element")
background = nuke.toNode("Plate")

if foreground is None or background is None:
    raise ValueError("Rename the source nodes to FG_Element and Plate, or update the names in this script.")

merge = nuke.createNode("Merge2")
merge.setName("FG_over_Plate")
merge.setInput(0, foreground)  # A: foreground
merge.setInput(1, background)  # B: background

# Standard premultiplied foreground-over-background composite.
merge["operation"].setValue("over")
merge["Achannels"].setValue("rgba")
merge["Bchannels"].setValue("rgba")
merge["output"].setValue("rgba")

# Preserve the full area covered by either input.
merge["bbox"].setValue("union")
merge["mix"].setValue(1.0)
